definitions.short: a snail (as if floating in its own slime)
definitions.full: H7642. shabluwl שַׁבְּלוּל noun masculine snail (Shaph`el form, causing moisture , from notion of moisture or fluid in בלל ); — name due to slimy trail Psa 58:9 , יַהֲלֹךְ תֶּמֶס שַׁבְּלוּל .
